source: Survey of India, 'Length of Coastline of India' (11,098.81 km), promulgated by the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways on 29 April 2025; old and revised lengths in the Ministry of Earth Sciences' Parliament answer of 4 December 2025. The official note gives one general reason for every state, 'probable variation in scale and calculation methods', not one for West Bengal. 12 states and UTs have both lengths.
